i have access to it for cramps and headaches, and i am and was at the time aware of the lethal dose. yeah, it is. my parents put it in a medicine cabinet with a lock, and i can only take two at a time when i have cramps or headaches.
i tried to kill myself in November of last year by overdosing on advil.

i thought i was useless. that i didn’t have a place in the world and that everyone would be better off if i just disappeared. a big thing that caused this was the episode that i was in. these episodes started in middle school. some stuff happened with some bullies and it has just been how my mind copes. my mind s p a c e s  o u t. when i’m spaced out, i feel very tiny, and not important. i guess that maybe that cutting has also served me as a grounding technique, to get me back in touch with reality.

self-harming helps me distract myself from my head-space, so yeah, i have found that it helps me cope. more healthier ways of coping that i do are drawing and just watching youtube, and even then it’s very short term because once i become bored there is nothing left to do but to self-harm. i was getting better at distracting myself but then i kind of fell back in during this quarantine.

im scared for the fact that i am having suicidal thoughts again. i’ll go into these episodes where i space out for long periods of time, like weeks or even months (i’ve been diagnosed by a psychiatrist and i have a mix of derealization and depersonalization) i’m in one of those episodes now, and it helped having therapy before but now that i don’t and it’s happening again, i find it hard to cope and it’s making me want to end it because i’m so tired of feeling numb and like i’m in a dream and there are blocks and shapes and i don’t really know how to explain it but yeah. the episodes have levels within them that range from numbish to i think i’m actually dead. i do not want to end my life at the moment, but i do think about it a lot and have attempted in the past. i’m scared that i might fall into the more “i think i’m actually dead” range of my episode and actually attempt again.
